messages:
noah: Hi all 1 1 quick help - my insurance card shows coverage from 2026-05-01 but I had to get urgent meds today. Can I get a one-off reimbursement or an advance? cc @lisa :grimacing:
benefits-bot: Enrollment status: processed. Carrier effective date 2026-05-01. For retro reviews, submit receipts to Expensify with category `healthcare-reimbursements`. Link: https://redwood.intranet/benefits/reimbursements
lisa: Hey Noah 1 welcome aboard. Sorry about the timing. Two options: 1) file for retro review with carrier (we submit) or 2) request a short-term payroll advance for essential meds. Which do you prefer?
noah: If carrier retro might take a week, an advance would be ideal. What's required to get an advance?
tom-payroll: For an advance request: open a People Ops ticket, subject `advance-request: medical`, attach the receipt and a short note. Payroll approval usually same-day to next business day. We'll recover the advance from future payroll in up to 3 installments unless you request otherwise.
lisa: Also please redact full card numbers and SSNs before uploading. Keep provider name, service date, itemized charge, and Rx name.
mia: FYI we had a similar case last month where benefits admin got a retro approval so carrier covered. If you want us to try carrier first, mention `please attempt retro` in the ticket. That prompts a parallel carrier submission and keeps the advance option open.
noah: Thanks. Created ticket #PO-4123 with receipt attached and noted `please attempt retro; request advance if denied`. Uploaded Expensify ER-9012 under `healthcare-reimbursements`.
benefits-bot: Ticket PO-4123 logged. Benefits admin will review; expected response 2-4 business days. If urgent, payroll will review advance request immediately.
lisa: I see the ticket 1 I'll ping the admin now. Quick note for record: Example Expensify memo to copy-paste:
```
Provider: City Pharmacy
Date of service: 2026-04-18
Service: Prescription - 30 day supply
Amount: $46.20
Category: healthcare-reimbursements
Notes: New-hire retro request. Please escalate for carrier review. If denied, please process payroll advance PO-4123.
```
noah: Appreciate it, team :relieved:
